Design, develop, and maintain AI-powered and web applications using Python, Django/Flask, FastAPI, React, REST APIs, LLMs, RAG, and agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph. Provision and manage application infrastructure across OpenStack and Azure, including VMs, application hosting, Nginx, HTTPS/TLS, and supporting services. Managing secrets and credentials through KeyVaults (TBD) 

 Qualifications 
 Your skills and experience 5-8Yrs experience in Python software development experience with Django, Flask, FastAPI, or equivalent frameworks. Experience building LLM/GenAI applications, RAG solutions, and AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent frameworks. Strong understanding of Git, GitLab, CI/CD, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, and application deployment. Working experience with cloud/virtualized infrastructure, preferably Azure and OpenStack. Experience with Nginx, HTTPS/TLS, Linux/Windows server environments, and application services. Working knowledge of React/JavaScript for maintaining web applications. Experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent. Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to independently take an application from requirement, design, development, deployment to production support. Strong appetite for continuous learning and experimentation, with the ability to independently explore emerging AI, software, cloud, and developer technologies, rapidly build proofs-of-concept, and identify opportunities to apply them to enterprise solutions. Nice-To-Have Docker/Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell. Azure AI/Azure OpenAI, vector databases/pgVector, MCP, and AI evaluation/observability, RAGAS RAG evaluation, ML, fine-tuning. Experience with enterprise identity, authentication, and security platforms. Experience with SharePoint, Power BI, Power Apps, and Microsoft Copilot Studio, including integration with enterprise applications, data sources, workflows, and AI-powered business solutions.

Good understanding of full-stack web application development.
Ability to troubleshoot issues and work independently on assigned tasks.
Strong communication, collaboration, and time-management skills.
Willingness to learn new technologies and follow coding standards.
Comfortable working on-site in Noida, Uttar Pradesh .

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to understand existing code and implement enhancements.
Clear communication regarding progress, challenges, and blockers.
Openness to feedback and collaboration with team members.
Commitment to continuous learning and code quality.

Hands-on experience with real-world projects.
